extracted.intended_audience: students studying North Carolina colonial history (middle/high school)
extracted.subtask_description: Comprehension and review questions for textbook chapters covering Governors Dobbs, Tryon, Martin, the Stamp Act, the Regulators, and the early Provincial Congresses in colonial North Carolina.
